name: Night Eagle Wilderness Adventures
description_short: A small, primitive overnight camp for no more than 36 boys ages 10 to 14 near Wallingford, Vermont, where campers live in tipis without electronics. It is built around 3- to 6-week sessions, with 1- and 2-week options for young or new campers.
refund_policy_summary: If notice of withdrawal reaches the camp office by May 1, tuition is refunded minus a $100 processing fee. After May 1 there are no refunds for withdrawals, session changes, late arrivals or no-shows. The one exception is documented physical illness of the camper, which gets back 50% of unused tuition. If illness or accident cuts a stay short, tuition is refunded pro rata. There is no refund if a camper is sent home for breaking camp rules or is withdrawn voluntarily. If the camp cancels a session, all money is refunded.
